children: Flex announced a definitive agreement to acquire EPC Power for $4.4 billion in cash, using a locked-box dated June 30, 2026. The transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary conditions including HSR clearance, and EPC Power will join Flex's Cloud and Power Infrastructure business ahead of a planned 2027 spin-off. To support the acquisition, Flex also obtained a senior unsecured 364-day bridge commitment of up to $4.4 billion from Citigroup Global Markets, Bank of America and BofA Securities, which it intends to replace with a mix of debt and equity.
